source_snapshot.items: UMC Replay Correctable CRC Read In Band
source_snapshot.procedure: Enable amdgpu RAS, prove UMC count zero, inject device0/block0/subtype0/type4/address0x800.
source_snapshot.criteria: Injection success, expected dmesg hardware error and post-injection UMC count nonzero.
source_snapshot.deepseek: Generic FAE-approved in-band GPU error injection with dedicated-SUT warning.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: RPUC/IMPROVED; require exact replay CRC parameters, stable identity, zero baseline, counter/log evidence and recovery.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Correct safety gate but lacks the CRC-read replay subtype and evidence detail.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains the source command and calls for an attributable count transition.
historical_reviews.related_cases: Row452 is correctable ODECC type2; row454 is replay ODECC subtype2/type4; these are separate fault mechanisms.

original_test_intent: Inject one approved UMC replay correctable CRC-read event at address 0x800 into a known AMD GPU and verify the scoped UMC counter and correlated logs reflect the expected recoverable event.
original_method: Map device0 to serial/UUID/BDF/OAM; pin amdgpuras/driver/firmware and confirm -b0 -s0 -t4 -a0x800 semantics with FAE; preserve preexisting UMC counters and logs; establish a scoped zero baseline or exception; inject once; record output/exit/time; require the expected counter delta and CRC-read/correctable UMC log evidence; monitor GPU health; perform only approved reset/cleanup and prove recovery.
manual_activity: AMD/FAE approves CRC-read replay semantics; GPU owner isolates the SUT and owns OOB/recovery.
required_inputs: Expected count delta and log/SEL/CPER fields
safety_requirements: Abort on escalation, GPU loss or hang; no retry

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Generic gating aligns, but source-specific subtype/type/address must not be replaced.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After approval run `sudo amdgpuras -d 0 -b 0 -s 0 -t 4 -a 0x800` once and query the same mapped block before/after.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Device0, block0, subtype0, type4, address0x800, count transition and dmesg retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Correlate one injection timestamp to an exact per-GPU counter delta and CRC-read event fields across OS/BMC evidence.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds stable identity, numeric delta, one-shot safety and verified recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Generic hardware-error text cannot prove CRC-read replay subtype or correctable handling.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Prior counter state and firmware-specific encoding can mask or misclassify the injected event.

project_override_considerations: Owner defines acceptable preexisting counts, exact expected increment, message/severity/CPER behavior and reset/cleanup requirement.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: DeepSeek is generic but agrees on in-band RAS injection and dedicated-SUT controls.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Static review complete; execution gated by hazardous target/parameter/oracle/recovery confirmation.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Compatibility row453 Wistron-AMD GPU-00150-V003: approve device0 serial/UUID/BDF/OAM, amdgpuras/driver/firmware and ras_enable policy, -b0 -s0 -t4 -a0x800 CRC-read replay semantics, baseline/expected UMC counter delta, dmesg/SEL/CPER correctable oracle, one-shot abort and recovery.

review_improvement: Makes CRC-read replay independently identifiable instead of accepting any generic nonzero UMC error.
independent_technical_reasoning: Rows using the same UMC block differ only by subtype/type, so a generic success string or nonzero counter cannot distinguish coverage. The parameter tuple and correlated event content must uniquely identify CRC-read replay.
